{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Environment

|descr= Returns the current humidity value. 0 is no humidity and 1 is 100% humidity. Humidity value quickly changes from 0 to 1 when rain starts, then slowly changes from 1 to 0 when rain stops.

|s1= '''humidity'''

|r1= [[Number]] in range 0..1

|x1= <sqf>currentHumidity = humidity;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
skipTime -24;
86400 setOvercast 1;
skipTime 24;
0 spawn {
	10 setRain 1;
	sleep 10;
	10 setRain 0;
};
onEachFrame {
	hintSilent str [round (rain * 10) / 10, round (humidity * 10) / 10];
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[setHumidity]] [[simulSetHumidity]] [[setOvercast]] [[setRain]] [[rain]] [[overcast]] [[fog]] [[wind]] [[waves]]
}}
